description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across different layers, comparing three gating conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to slightly above 0.8, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003" is represented by a blue dashed line without markers; it starts at approximately 0.02 at Layer 0, drops to nearly 0.0 by Layer 1, and maintains a steady, flat trend at 0.0 through the end of the x-axis at Layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It begins at a peak value of approximately 0.84 at Layer 0, experiences a sharp decline to roughly 0.42 at Layer 1, and continues to decrease gradually to about 0.02 by Layer 12, followed by minor fluctuations including a small peak near 0.08 at Layer 21, before ending at approximately 0.05 at Layer 23. Finally, the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080" is depicted by a green dash-dot line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.78 at Layer 0, drops sharply to about 0.28 at Layer 1, and steadily declines to near 0.01 by Layer 10, remaining relatively flat at this level until it ends near 0.0 at Layer 23.
